title: ArticleShape
description: Schema for Article entities following Open Pulse Ontology v2.1.2. Optimized for LLM agent parsing with descriptive guidance. ID hierarchy: doi → infoscienceArticleIdentifier → uuid. SHACL requires: schema:name, schema:identifier (DOI), schema:datePublished, schema:author (min 1).

id.description: Resolved hierarchical identifier. Set to the first non-null value from: schema:identifier (DOI), pulse:infoscienceArticleIdentifier, or uuid (fallback). Example: '10.1038/s41586-024-07856-z'

identifiers.description: All available identifiers for this article. Contains schema:identifier (DOI), pulse:infoscienceArticleIdentifier, and uuid

schema:identifier.description: DOI identifier in canonical URL form. Format: https://doi.org/10.XXXX/suffix. Example: 'https://doi.org/10.1038/s41586-024-07856-z'

pulse:infoscienceArticleIdentifier.description: Infoscience article identifier in canonical URL form (`https://infoscience.epfl.ch/entities/publication/<uuid>`). Example: 'https://infoscience.epfl.ch/entities/publication/f97b60da-bcab-4f2e-ba12-0ee0c4d0d6eb'

uuid.description: UUID4 fallback identifier. Always present. Example: 'f8a3b2c1-4d5e-4f6a-8b9c-1d2e3f4a5b6c'

idSource.description: Indicates which identifier was used as the primary 'id'. One of: 'schema:identifier', 'pulse:infoscienceArticleIdentifier', or 'uuid'

schema:name.description: Article title. REQUIRED per SHACL. Example: 'Open Pulse: A Framework for Tracking Scientific Software Contributions'

schema:identifier.description: DOI identifier in canonical URL form. REQUIRED per SHACL. Format: https://doi.org/10.XXXX/suffix. Example: 'https://doi.org/10.1038/s41586-024-07856-z'

schema:datePublished.description: Publication date. REQUIRED per SHACL. Format: ISO 8601 date (YYYY-MM-DD). Example: '2025-06-15'

schema:author.description: Array of PersonShape hierarchical IDs. REQUIRED per SHACL (min 1 author). Uses target's resolved id (could be ORCID, GitHub username, or UUID). Example: ['0000-0001-2345-6789', 'mweber']

pulse:infoscienceArticleIdentifier.description: Infoscience article identifier in canonical URL form (`https://infoscience.epfl.ch/entities/publication/<uuid>`). Example: 'https://infoscience.epfl.ch/entities/publication/f97b60da-bcab-4f2e-ba12-0ee0c4d0d6eb'

schema:sourceOrganization.description: Reference to OrganizationShape hierarchical ID. Uses target's resolved id (could be ROR, GitHub org handle, or UUID). Example: 'https://ror.org/02s376052'
